instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium shot. In a festively decorated room, three friends stand side-by-side. On the left, the man with curly hair (R8) in a red polo shirt smiles with Canadian flags painted on his cheeks. In the center, the man with the red bandana (R5) smiles, draping his arms over the shoulders of the man with curly hair (R8) and the man with glasses (R4) on the right, who wears a white sweatshirt. In the background right, a blurry woman stands near a table. Warm, natural indoor lighting fills the space.
